TileStructure.Forest.global_tree_control.statement: (Part 2 of equation (7.5.18) of Lemma 7.5.9, per the docstring.) Let $X$ be a metric space, let $a \in \mathbb{N}$, $q \in \mathbb{R}$, $K : X \to X \to \mathbb{C}$, $\sigma_1, \sigma_2 : X \to \mathbb{Z}$ and $F, G \subseteq X$, and assume `ProofData a q K σ₁ σ₂ F G` (which provides the measure `volume` on $X$) and a tile structure `TileStructure Q (defaultD a) (defaultκ a) (defaultS X) (cancelPt X)`, with tiles $\mathfrak{P}(X)$ (`𝔓 X`) and grid cubes `Grid X`. Write $D \in \mathbb{N}$ for `defaultD a`. For a grid cube $J$, write $c(J) \in X$ for its centre `c J` and $s(J) \in \mathbb{Z}$ for its scale `s J`; for a tile $p$, write $\mathfrak{c}(p) \in X$ for `𝔠 p`, $\mathfrak{s}(p) \in \mathbb{Z}$ for `𝔰 p`, and $\mathcal{I}(p)$ for its grid cube `𝓘 p`; $B(y, r)$ is the open ball in $X$ of centre $y$ and radius $r \in \mathbb{R}$. Let $n \in \mathbb{N}$ and let $t$ be a forest `Forest X n`; for a tile $u$, $\mathfrak{T}(u)$ denotes `t.𝔗 u`, and for tiles $u_1, u_2$, $\mathfrak{S}_0(u_1,u_2)$ and $\mathcal{J}_5(u_1,u_2)$ denote `t.𝔖₀ u₁ u₂` and `t.𝓙₅ u₁ u₂`. For a set $\mathfrak{C}$ of tiles and $h : X \to \mathbb{C}$, $T^*_{\mathfrak{C}} h : X \to \mathbb{C}$ denotes `adjointCarlesonSum ℭ h`; for a tile $u$, $\mathcal{Q}(u)(x) \in \mathbb{R}$ denotes the value at $x \in X$ of `𝒬 u`. Finally, $M h(y) \in [0,\infty]$ denotes `maximalFunction volume Forest.𝓑 Forest.c𝓑 Forest.r𝓑 1 h y`, the maximal function with exponent $1$ associated with the ball family `Forest.𝓑` with centres `Forest.c𝓑` and radii `Forest.r𝓑`; $\|\cdot\|_e$ is the extended norm in $[0,\infty]$ and $\mathrm{edist}$ is the extended distance in $[0,\infty]$. Let $u \in \mathfrak{P}(X)$ with $u \in t$, let $\mathfrak{C} \subseteq \mathfrak{T}(u)$ be a set of tiles, let $J$ be a grid cube, let $f : X \to \mathbb{C}$ be bounded with compact support (with respect to `volume`), and suppose that every $p \in \mathfrak{C}$ for which $B(\mathfrak{c}(p), 8D^{\mathfrak{s}(p)})$ and $B(c(J), 16D^{s(J)})$ are not disjoint satisfies $s(J) \le \mathfrak{s}(p)$. Let $x, x' \in X$ with $x, x' \in B(c(J), 16D^{s(J)})$. Then $$\mathrm{edist}\big(e^{i\mathcal{Q}(u)(x)} T^*_{\mathfrak{C}} f(x),\ e^{i\mathcal{Q}(u)(x')} T^*_{\mathfrak{C}} f(x')\big) \le C_{7.5.9d}(a) \Big(\frac{\mathrm{edist}(x,x')}{D^{s(J)}}\Big)^{1/a} \inf_{y \in J} M f(y),$$ computed in $[0,\infty]$, where $C_{7.5.9d}$ is `Forest.C7_5_9d`.

(Equation (7.5.18) of Lemma 7.5.9 for $\mathfrak{C} = \mathfrak{T}(u_2) \cap \mathfrak{S}_0(u_1,u_2)$, per the docstring.) For a grid cube $J$, write $c(J) \in X$ for its centre `c J` and $s(J) \in \mathbb{Z}$ for its scale `s J`; for a tile $p$, write $\mathfrak{c}(p) \in X$ for `𝔠 p`, $\mathfrak{s}(p) \in \mathbb{Z}$ for `𝔰 p`, and $\mathcal{I}(p)$ for its grid cube `𝓘 p`; $B(y, r)$ is the open ball in $X$ of centre $y$ and radius $r \in \mathbb{R}$. Let $n \in \mathbb{N}$ and let $t$ be a forest `Forest X n`; for a tile $u$, $\mathfrak{T}(u)$ denotes `t.𝔗 u`, and for tiles $u_1, u_2$, $\mathfrak{S}_0(u_1,u_2)$ and $\mathcal{J}_5(u_1,u_2)$ denote `t.𝔖₀ u₁ u₂` and `t.𝓙₅ u₁ u₂`. For a set $\mathfrak{C}$ of tiles and $h : X \to \mathbb{C}$, $T^*_{\mathfrak{C}} h : X \to \mathbb{C}$ denotes `adjointCarlesonSum ℭ h`; for a tile $u$, $\mathcal{Q}(u)(x) \in \mathbb{R}$ denotes the value at $x \in X$ of `𝒬 u`. Finally, $M h(y) \in [0,\infty]$ denotes `maximalFunction volume Forest.𝓑 Forest.c𝓑 Forest.r𝓑 1 h y`, the maximal function with exponent $1$ associated with the ball family `Forest.𝓑` with centres `Forest.c𝓑` and radii `Forest.r𝓑`; $\|\cdot\|_e$ is the extended norm in $[0,\infty]$ and $\mathrm{edist}$ is the extended distance in $[0,\infty]$. Let $u_1, u_2 \in \mathfrak{P}(X)$ be tiles with $u_1 \in t$, $u_2 \in t$, $u_1 \ne u_2$ and $\mathcal{I}(u_1) \le \mathcal{I}(u_2)$, let $J$ be a grid cube with $J \in \mathcal{J}_5(u_1,u_2)$, and let $f : X \to \mathbb{C}$ be bounded with compact support (with respect to `volume`). Let $x, x' \in X$ with $x, x' \in B(c(J), 16D^{s(J)})$. Then $$\mathrm{edist}\big(e^{i\mathcal{Q}(u_2)(x)} T^*_{\mathfrak{T}(u_2) \cap \mathfrak{S}_0(u_1,u_2)} f(x),\ e^{i\mathcal{Q}(u_2)(x')} T^*_{\mathfrak{T}(u_2) \cap \mathfrak{S}_0(u_1,u_2)} f(x')\big) \le C_{7.5.9d}(a) \Big(\frac{\mathrm{edist}(x,x')}{D^{s(J)}}\Big)^{1/a} \inf_{y \in J} M f(y),$$ computed in $[0,\infty]$, where $C_{7.5.9d}$ is `Forest.C7_5_9d`.

(Equation (7.5.17) of Lemma 7.5.9, per the docstring.) Let $X$ be a metric space, let $a \in \mathbb{N}$, $q \in \mathbb{R}$, $K : X \to X \to \mathbb{C}$, $\sigma_1, \sigma_2 : X \to \mathbb{Z}$ and $F, G \subseteq X$, and assume `ProofData a q K σ₁ σ₂ F G` (which provides the measure `volume` on $X$) and a tile structure `TileStructure Q (defaultD a) (defaultκ a) (defaultS X) (cancelPt X)`, with tiles $\mathfrak{P}(X)$ (`𝔓 X`) and grid cubes `Grid X`.
